name: DSP-16
description: RISC-16 with a hardware multiplier, the heart of a digital signal processor: MUL R0, R1, R2 multiplies two 4.12 fixed point numbers in one instruction, which is what it takes to draw the Mandelbrot set in colour and close in on it.
tagline: A hardware multiplier and the Mandelbrot set

programs.name: Mandelbrot, 80 x 60
programs.description: The whole set in 8 x 8 pixel blocks: seconds at full speed

programs.name: Mandelbrot, 160 x 120
programs.description: The same picture in 4 x 4 pixel blocks: four times the points

programs.name: Mandelbrot, 640 x 480
programs.description: Every pixel of the screen its own point: minutes at full speed

programs.name: Lightning at the top of the set
programs.description: A close up of the tip at the top of the set, 24 times nearer, where it branches into filaments full of tiny copies of itself
